_band_policy: Bands are read verbatim from each case's `acceptance` block in the generated case table: the `analytical` slot is the primary criterion where the standard publishes a quasi-analytical solution (null for every §9 case today), the `comparative` slot is the Task-22 ensemble evidence range otherwise. No band is fitted to the engine output and no band is widened.
_doc: Recorded ASHRAE 140-2023 Section 9 CE100-CE200 engine-run results and per-case acceptance-band rows (Issue #4296). GENERATED by the §9 engine-run harness (tests/validation/hvac_equipment_rated_performance/section9_engine_run.rs) — re-record with FLUXION_SECTION9_WRITE_RESULTS; never hand-edit.
_entering_condition_policy: The per-case entering wet-bulb is not transcribed for 13 of the 14 CE cases (the 140-2023 §9 input specification is licensed, #4285). The harness dispatches every case at every entering wet-bulb column the map tabulates and reports the envelope; it does not attribute a column to a case.

_metric_mapping.annual_cooling: not reproducible: needs the normative TMY2 weather file (licensed, never committed); a steady-state dispatch has no duty cycle.
_metric_mapping.max_zone_temp: not reproducible: needs the annual zone-temperature trajectory; the steady-state dispatch holds the case setpoint.
_metric_mapping.peak_cooling: scored against the engine's full-load cooling power at the case condition (compressor power + 230 W indoor fan, adjusted-net basis). The ensemble semantics (peak cooling load vs peak cooling power) are unverified (bounds CSV source_page = pending).

_status_legend.known_fail: the engine value falls outside the band — recorded with the real numbers, tracked in docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md §LIMIT-42
_status_legend.no_band: the case carries no band at all (comparative bounds missing)
_status_legend.not_reproducible: the band metric cannot be produced by this run (coverage gap)
_status_legend.pass: the engine value falls inside the band

bands.band_role: evidence range (ensemble min/max), not a pass/fail criterion
bands.band_source: tests/validation/hvac_equipment_rated_performance/data/comparative_bounds_ce100_ce200.csv (IEA SHC Task 22 ensemble bounds; originally published as task-22 identifier E100)
bands.reason: annual total: the case's normative TMY2 weather file (CE100A) is licensed ASHRAE supplemental material and is never committed to this repository (fluxion-core/src/weather/tm2.rs); a steady-state equipment dispatch has no duty cycle, so the annual band cannot be reproduced from the engine run. Tracked as a coverage gap for CE100 (methodology follow-up F1, licensed gate #4285).

bands.band_role: evidence range (ensemble min/max), not a pass/fail criterion
bands.band_source: tests/validation/hvac_equipment_rated_performance/data/comparative_bounds_ce100_ce200.csv (IEA SHC Task 22 ensemble bounds; originally published as task-22 identifier E100)
bands.engine_metric_definition: full-load cooling power at the case condition = compressor power at PLR=1 + the map's 230 W indoor fan heat (adjusted-net basis)
bands.reason: comparative band metric scored against the steady-state engine run. The ensemble metric semantics (peak cooling load vs peak cooling power) are not verifiable from this tree — the bounds CSV records source_page 'pending' — and the value ladder in that file is placeholder-patterned (the CE100 peak_cooling row is byte-identical to the AE300 row of comparative_bounds_ae101_ae445.csv). The band was read verbatim and not widened; the case's own entering wet-bulb is untranscribed, so the row covers every entering condition the map tabulates.
